row.name: Luck / Extraordinary Luck
row.description: The Force favors you, even if you aren’t sensitive to it; the GM will occasionally give you rerolls or favorable circumstances. Extraordinary Luck gives more rerolls. Survival in the galaxy often comes down to sheer luck, allowing you to escape impossible situations or stumble upon unexpected boons. Range: 15 points (Luck) to 30 points (Extraordinary Luck).
